newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds pare gains, seen rangebound on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bunds pare gains, seen rangebound on Thursday.

text.p: German Bunds pared gains in late trade on Wednesday after remaining moderately firm all day in a technical rebound from their sharp drop this week.
Dealers said investors had been unsettled by the recent losses and that trade focused on the futures market, while turnover in the cash bond market was minimal.
June Bund futures were quoted at 100.05 at 1550 GMT, up six basis points from Tuesday's close, after trading in a range of 99.93 to 100.34.
They hit the day's high in a brief jump following the news of a slowdown in February M3 growth to 9.1 percent from January's 11.7 percent.
The February Ifo business climate index released shortly afterwards had little effect since it was largely as expected.
The West German Ifo business climate index rose slightly to 93.6 from 93.3. Analysts said the data pointed to a modest economic pick-up.
"We're seeing pure range trading here, there's no particular impetus in one direction or the other," one Frankfurt-based bond dealer said.
"The data were largely in line and had little effect. There's a lot of uncertainty in the market after Monday's plunge and the market is finding its floor."
